rules.description: Use DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself). Reuse existing components, hooks, and utils from /src/components, /src/hooks, and /src/lib instead of duplicating logic.
Follow consistent naming conventions: use `useXyz` for hooks, `XyzCard.tsx` for UI, and snake_case for filenames if not React components.
All reusable code (hooks, utils, types) must live in /src/hooks or /src/lib. Avoid creating these in component folders.
Every new API or utility function must be documented in `docs/api.md` with description, inputs, and expected outputs.
All features should be added to `docs/features.md` with a [ ] or [x] checkbox for tracking.
Any bugs found should be logged in `docs/bugs.md` and referenced by filename + line number if possible.
OpenAI prompts should be abstracted into `/src/lib/ai/prompts.ts` with named functions and reusable templates.
Prefer functional tests over unit tests for UI flows. Use mock data where needed. Keep test files next to the components they test.
Cursor should suggest extracting logic into hooks or utils when a file exceeds 100 lines or repeats logic more than twice.
Use Vite and React for all new frontend modules. Avoid using Next.js SSR features for the extension.
